description: This file defines an abstract base class for Eclipse Hono service endpoints, providing common functionality such as lifecycle management, logging, tracing setup, and health check registration.

classes.name: AbstractEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for Vert.x-based service endpoints in Eclipse Hono, including lifecycle management, tracing setup, and health check registration.

methods.name: AbstractEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AbstractEndpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer to be used for request tracking.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the endpoint, with a default implementation completing immediately.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement startup logic.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the endpoint, with a default implementation completing immediately.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement shutdown logic.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Method for subclasses to register liveness health checks. Default does nothing.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Method for subclasses to register readiness health checks. Default does nothing.

methods.name: createEventBusMessageDeliveryOptions
methods.description: Creates DeliveryOptions for the Vert.x event bus, injecting a SpanContext for distributed tracing.
